annotation.title_clean: „Polityka rozwoju sztucznej inteligencji w Polsce do 2030 roku” - bezpieczne i odpowiedzialne wykorzystanie sztucznej inteligencji
annotation.title_en: Policy for the Development of Artificial Intelligence in Poland to 2030 - safe and responsible use of AI
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerstwo Cyfryzacji (Ministry of Digital Affairs, Poland)
annotation.summary_en: Ministry of Digital Affairs news page announcing the updated Polish AI Development Policy to 2030, revised after public consultation. It covers AI infrastructure, public administration, key sectors, SME support including regulatory sandboxes, human-centred trustworthy AI and disinformation tools. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Updated AI Policy to 2030 published 17 Nov 2025 after consultations, with measurable output and result indicators.
AI infrastructure: PLGrid, AI Factories in Poznań and Kraków, planned Baltic AI GigaFactory.
Lodz and Upper Silesian-Zagłębie Metropolis join leading AI centres from 1 Jan 2027.
AI HUB Poland platform and PLLuM pilots for public administration; sectoral deployment maps.
SME support includes regulatory sandboxes; tool against AI-generated disinformation; alignment with EU Apply AI Strategy.
